name: Toolbar
statusNote: Floating toolbar and docked toolbar both have no M2/M3-classic equivalent; docked toolbar replaces the deprecated bottom app bar.
summary: A floating toolbar surfaces contextual actions for the content beneath it and can float anywhere on screen, optionally paired with a FAB; a docked toolbar spans the window width with actions that stay constant across pages, replacing the bottom app bar.

inputs.name: expanded
inputs.description: Floating toolbar only: whether the leading/trailing content group is showing.

inputs.name: floatingActionButton
inputs.description: Floating toolbar only: an adjacent standard or vibrant FAB, sized and elevated in sync with the toolbar's expand state.

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: The toolbar's icon buttons, buttons, or overflow menu, laid out in a row (horizontal) or column (vertical).

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description: Floating toolbar only; docked toolbars are always horizontal.

inputs.name: colorStyle
inputs.description: standard is neutral-coloured; vibrant is a high-emphasis primary-tinted colour.

inputs.name: fabPosition
inputs.description: Where the paired FAB sits relative to the toolbar. start/end apply when horizontal, top/bottom/center when vertical.

inputs.name: docked
inputs.description: Selects the full-width docked toolbar instead of the floating pill.

inputs.name: scrollBehavior
inputs.description: exit-always collapses the bar toward its exit direction on scroll.

anatomy.name: Elements
anatomy.description: Icon buttons, buttons, or an overflow menu.

anatomy.name: Leading/trailing content group
anatomy.description: Floating toolbars only: an optional group either side of the main row/column, shown only while expanded.

anatomy.name: Paired FAB
anatomy.description: Floating only: an adjacent standard or vibrant floating action button, sized and elevated in sync with the toolbar's expand state.

variants.description: Actions floating over content, neutral colour.
Column layout for side placement, standard or vibrant.
Toolbar shrinks and FAB grows to fill freed space, and vice versa.

layout.text: The floating container clips to container-shape and never changes shape between expanded and collapsed — only its size animates.
Minimum floating container height is container-height.
Content padding uses container-leading-space/container-trailing-space on all sides; screen offset from the edge equals container-external-padding.
The gap between the floating toolbar and a paired FAB is hard-coded, not a token.
The paired FAB's diameter is not a toolbar token: it interpolates across a fixed size range (FAB baseline width to FAB medium width) as expand progress goes from 1 to 0.
Scroll-to-hide distance threshold is hard-coded, not a token.

Full-width container; container-leading-space/container-trailing-space inset the end elements; container-min-spacing/container-max-spacing bound the gap between elements as the bar reflows; container-shape is unrounded, unlike the floating toolbar's full pill.

states.text: A 0..1 progress animates with the toolbar's default animation spec, which resolves to a spatial spring. Toolbar width and FAB diameter key off the same progress, so they move in lockstep; non-FAB leading/trailing content enters/exits with the same spring.

states.label: padding-bounce
states.text: When leading/trailing content toggles, the content row's padding re-balances with a default-effects spring.

states.label: shadow-crossfade
states.text: Elevation lerps between collapsed/expanded values on the expand progress, with no separate spring, for the FAB-paired layout; the non-FAB layout animates shadow with the fast-spatial spring instead.

states.label: scroll-to-hide
states.text: exit-always scroll behaviour collapses the bar toward its exit direction immediately on scroll; on release it snaps fully open or closed, whichever is nearer, plus a spline decay (not a spring) for residual fling velocity.

behaviour.text: A separate nested-scroll expand/collapse mechanism toggles past an expand or collapse scroll-distance threshold, both defaulting to the same 40dp scroll distance threshold used for scroll-to-hide.
With a screen reader active the toolbar forces itself expanded and ignores scroll behaviour; a custom accessibility action lets the user toggle expand/collapse explicitly.
Standard container uses standard-container-color with an on-colour derived content colour.
Vibrant container uses vibrant-container-color; its selectable buttons use the vibrant-button-selected-*/vibrant-button-unselected-* triad (icon, text, container) for pressed/toggled state.
The paired FAB's colours are not toolbar tokens: the standard FAB uses primary-container, the vibrant FAB uses tertiary-container.

Docked toolbar standard/vibrant follow the same two-scheme pattern as floating, and MDC pairs it with a hide-on-scroll behaviour, but this is inferred from MDC prose — Compose has no expand/collapse or colour-crossfade implementation to cite for it.

keyboard: Tab moves through each action element in order.
Enter or Space activates the focused element.
semantics: Non-modal toolbar: generic container/toolbar role with focusable action children; each child's touch target follows its own component spec.
Floating toolbar exposes explicit expand/collapse custom accessibility actions and stays expanded under touch exploration, so actions are never screen-reader-unreachable.
A fully scroll-hidden floating toolbar drops out of the focus order.

notes.text: Docked toolbar is under-specified at this pinned commit: the androidx tree has no DockedToolbar/DockedToolbarLayout composable, only HorizontalFloatingToolbar/VerticalFloatingToolbar and DockedToolbarTokens.kt. Everything about docked toolbar behaviour is inferred from MDC-Android's DockedToolbar.md (View-system behaviour, not Compose) plus tokens it shares in spirit with the floating toolbar. Treat its motion springs and shape-morph as unconfirmed until a Compose implementation lands.
MDC shows a docked-toolbar variant with an embedded primary action button in place of a paired FAB; no equivalent exists in Compose's floating toolbar API.
Floating toolbar's FAB gap (8dp) and scroll threshold (40dp) are hard-coded in source with a TODO to load them from component tokens — expect them to move into tokens later.
Container/collapsed/expanded elevation defaults are literally Level0 with a TODO to read from token — not yet wired to sys.elevation.*.
